scope: Disposable synthetic queue diagnostics only; no runtime or shipping artifact change
changes: Capture up to 4096 stack characters at all four executor/observer catches, in addition to the existing 1024-character message bound.
Read message and stack independently and contain both reads and console failures. Unprintable thrown values still produce a phase marker.
Add an opt-in bundled-WebKit positive control for engine-created exceptions, all four catch sites, and failing logger containment. This uses a synthetic queue fixture, not the production editor.

nativeComparison.reason: Computer-use tool reported the Mac locked and automatic unlock unavailable; native Safari requires the user to unlock it.

limits: A passing rerun is not a fix or proof of absence of the intermittent fault.
Catch instrumentation changes the diagnostic bundle and may affect reproduction timing.
Stacks may contain local URLs; inspect diagnostic artifacts before sharing.
No package promotion, push, publish, or version change.
